title: The kidneys
examples: What exactly do the kidneys do for our blood?
How do the kidneys keep our body's water levels right?
Where does the waste from our blood go after the kidneys clean it?

explain.say: The kidneys have a very important job in keeping us healthy.
They work like a natural filter to clean the blood that flows through us.
The waste materials that are removed from the blood are what we call waste products.
The liquid waste that leaves the body after filtering is called urine.
Kidneys also help us keep a good water balance in our bodies.
When you drink too much water, the kidneys help you pass it out as urine.

faq.q: What is the main job of the kidneys?
faq.a: The main job is to clean your blood and remove waste products. You might also ask: What do the kidneys clean? Or: How do the kidneys help keep us healthy?
asks: What is the purpose of the kidneys?

faq.a: Urine is mostly water, but it also contains waste products that the body needs to get rid of. You might ask: What is the liquid waste? Or: What do we excrete?

faq.q: How do kidneys manage water levels?
faq.a: They adjust how much water is in your urine to keep your body balanced. If you drink a lot, they make more urine. You might ask: Do kidneys control water? Or: How is water balance kept?
asks: How do kidneys keep us hydrated?

faq.a: Yes, the kidneys work almost all the time to keep your blood clean. You might ask: Do kidneys stop working? Or: Is kidney function constant?
asks: How often do kidneys filter blood?

faq.q: What happens if the kidneys do not work well?
faq.a: If they do not work well, waste products can build up in the blood, which is dangerous. You might ask: What are the dangers of kidney failure? Or: What happens if we have kidney problems?
asks: What are the signs of kidney problems?
What happens if I have kidney issues?

facts: The kidneys are bean-shaped organs located near the lower back.
They filter waste products, such as urea, from the blood.
They help maintain the correct balance of water and salts in the body.
The waste product removed by the kidneys is called urine.

quiz.say: The kidneys remove waste products from which fluid?
quiz.why: The kidneys are designed to filter the blood circulating through the body.

wrong.0: Water is the solvent, not the fluid being filtered for waste.
wrong.1: Salt is a substance that is regulated, not the main fluid being filtered.
wrong.3: Urine is the waste that has already been filtered out.

quiz.say: If you drink a very large amount of water, what will the kidneys do?

options.show: Keep all the water in the body
options.say: Keep all the water in the body

quiz.why: They will pass out the extra water to keep the body balanced.

wrong.1: Stopping filtration would let waste build up in the blood.
wrong.2: This would cause the body to become too full of water.
wrong.3: They must keep some salt levels correct for the body.

quiz.say: The waste product that leaves the body through the kidneys is called:
quiz.why: Urine is the specific liquid waste product formed after filtering blood.

wrong.0: This is a general term; urine is the specific name for the liquid.
wrong.1: Filter is the action, not the substance that is passed out.
wrong.3: Blood is what enters the kidney for cleaning.
